/scripts.value:
command deleteQuizliQuestion
	local tCurrentQuestionA, tQuestionDataA, tContentImageID
	local tQuestionType, tCurrentAudioBlobID, tBlobsToDelete
	
	if deleteListOfQuestions is empty then
		exit deleteQuizliQuestion
	end if
	
	repeat for each line xQuestionID in deleteListOfQuestions
		put cdb_read(authedUserQuestionsTable, xQuestionID, "local") into tCurrentQuestionA
		put tCurrentQuestionA[xQuestionID] into tCurrentQuestionA
		put tCurrentQuestionA["questionType"] into tQuestionType
		put tCurrentQuestionA["questionData"] into tQuestionDataA
		put tQuestionDataA["contentImage"] into tContentImageID
		if tContentImageID is not empty then
			put tContentImageID & lf after tBlobsToDelete
		end if
		
		repeat for each key xQuestionHash in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["question text"]
			repeat for each key xVoice in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["question text"][xQuestionHash]
				repeat for each key xLanguage in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["question text"][xQuestionHash][xVoice]
					put tQuestionDataA["audio"]["question text"][xQuestionHash][xVoice][xLanguage] into tCurrentAudioBlobID
					
					if tCurrentAudioBlobID is not empty then
						put tCurrentAudioBlobID & lf after tBlobsToDelete
					end if
				end repeat
			end repeat
		end repeat
		
		switch tQuestionType
			case "Multiple Choice"
				repeat for each key xAnswer in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["choices"]
					repeat for each key xChoiceHash in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["choices"][xAnswer]
						repeat for each key xVoice in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["choices"][xAnswer][xChoiceHash]
							repeat for each key xLanguage in tQuestionDataA["audio"]["choices"][xAnswer][xChoiceHash][xVoice]
								put tQuestionDataA["audio"]["choices"][xAnswer][xChoiceHash][xVoice][xLanguage] into tCurrentAudioBlobID
								
								if tCurrentAudioBlobID is not empty then
									put tCurrentAudioBlobID & lf after tBlobsToDelete
								end if
							end repeat
						end repeat
					end repeat
				end repeat
				break
		end switch
	end repeat
	delete char -1 of tBlobsToDelete
	
	if tBlobsToDelete is not empty then
		cdb_deleteBlob tBlobsToDelete, "local"
		cdb_deleteBlob tBlobsToDelete, "cloud"
	end if
	
	cdb_delete authedUserQuestionsTable, deleteListOfQuestions, "local"
	cdb_delete authedUserQuestionsTable, deleteListOfQuestions, "cloud"
end deleteQuizliQuestion
